officialText: Material, other than foam plastic used as interior trim, shall have a minimum Class C flame spread index and maximum smoke-developed index when tested in accordance with ASTM E 84 or UL 723 as described in Section 803.1.1. Combustible trim, excluding handrails and guardrails, shall not exceed 10 percent of the specific wall or ceiling area in which it is attached.
